## QL DSL reference (CodeQL, python) — auto-generated by agent.dslgen.extract
## 20/32 constructs kept (38% reduction). See dialect_codeql_python.manual.txt for the hand-authored reference.

### Query shape
```
<query>            ::= <imports> <newline> <config-module> <newline> <flow-alias> <newline> [<pathgraph-import>] <newline> <select-clause>

<imports>          ::= "import python"
                        "import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow"
                        "import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking"
                        "import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources"
                        {<concept-import>}          (* e.g. "import semmle.python.Concepts" *)

<config-module>    ::= "module" <ConfigName> "implements DataFlow::ConfigSig" "{"
                          <isSource-pred>
                          <isSink-pred>
                          [<isBarrier-pred>]
                          [<isAdditionalFlowStep-pred>]
                        "}"

<isSource-pred>    ::= "predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {"
                          "source instanceof" <source-class>            (* RemoteFlowSource | SensitiveDataSource | ThreatModelSource | ... *)
                        "}"

<isSink-pred>      ::= "predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {"
                          "sink = any(" <sink-class> " s )." <sink-accessor> "()"   (* e.g. SqlExecution.getSql, FileSystemAccess.getAPathArgument *)
                        "}"

<isBarrier-pred>   ::= "predicate isBarrier(DataFlow::Node node) {"
                          "node instanceof" <filter-class>               (* Escaping | SafeAccessCheck | ConstCompareBarrier | ... *)
                        "}"

<isAdditionalFlowStep-pred> ::= "predicate isAdditionalFlowStep(DataFlow::Node nodeFrom, DataFlow::Node nodeTo) {" <custom-step> "}"

<flow-alias>       ::= "module" <FlowName> "=" ("DataFlow::Global<" | "TaintTracking::Global<") <ConfigName> ">"

<pathgraph-import> ::= "import" <FlowName> "::PathGraph"          (* only for path-problem queries *)

<select-clause>    ::= <plain-select> | <path-select>

<plain-select>     ::= "from DataFlow::Node source, DataFlow::Node sink"
                        "where" <FlowName> "::flow(source, sink)"
                        "select sink, " <message> ", source, " <source-label>

<path-select>      ::= "from" <FlowName> "::PathNode source," <FlowName> "::PathNode sink"
                        "where" <FlowName> "::flowPath(source, sink)"
                        "select sink.getNode(), source, sink, " <message> ", source, " <source-label>
```

### Subset catalog

#### dataflow
- `class CodeExecution extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getCode()` — The argument dynamically executed as Python code (eval/exec-style); code-injection sink.
- `module MyConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig { predicate isSource(Node); predicate isSink(Node); predicate isBarrier(Node); predicate isAdditionalFlowStep(Node, Node); }` — The module signature you implement to declare a custom source/sink/barrier/extra-step configuration.
- `class Decoding/Encoding extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getAnInput()/getOutput()` — Deserialize/serialize-style transforms that auto-propagate taint input→output; Decoding is also a sink for unsafe deserialization.
- `class FileSystemAccess extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getAPathArgument()` — An argument to a filesystem operation interpreted as a path; path-injection/traversal sink.
- `predicate MyFlow::flow(DataFlow::Node source, DataFlow::Node sink)` — Holds if the configured source can reach the configured sink; the core existence check for a taint-tracking query.
- `predicate MyFlow::flowPath(PathNode source, PathNode sink); import MyFlow::PathGraph` — Path-query variant of flow() that also reconstructs the full source-to-sink path for @kind path-problem queries.
- `module MyFlow = DataFlow::Global<MyConfig>; module MyFlow = TaintTracking::Global<MyConfig>` — Instantiates a whole-program data-flow or taint-tracking analysis from a ConfigSig module.
- `class CookieWrite extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getHeaderArg(); predicate hasSecureFlag/hasHttpOnlyFlag(boolean)` — A cookie set on an HTTP response, plus its Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite attribute state; sink and misconfiguration check.
- `class HttpRedirectResponse extends HttpResponse instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getRedirectLocation()` — The target location of an HTTP redirect; open-redirect sink.
- `class HttpResponse extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getBody()` — The body node of a server HTTP response; sink for reflected XSS.
- `class ResponseHeaderWrite extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getNameArg(); DataFlow::Node getValueArg()` — The header name/value set on an HTTP response; sink for HTTP response-header/CRLF injection.
- `predicate DataFlow::localFlow(Node, Node); predicate TaintTracking::localTaint(Node, Node); predicate LocalSourceNode.flowsTo(Node); LocalSourceNode Node.getALocalSource()` — Cheap intra-procedural data/taint flow between two nodes, and finding the local origin of a value, for lightweight checks or configuration-free flow.
- `class SqlConstruction/SqlExecution extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getSql()` — The SQL text built or executed by a query call; SQL-injection sink.
- `class SystemCommandExecution extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getCommand()` — The command argument of a spawned OS process; classic command-injection sink.
- `class TemplateConstruction extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; DataFlow::Node getSourceArg()` — The template-source argument passed to a templating engine; server-side template-injection sink.

#### filter
- `class Escaping extends DataFlow::Node instanceof Range; subclasses HtmlEscaping, XmlEscaping, RegexEscaping, LdapDnEscaping, LdapFilterEscaping` — A node that escapes meta-characters for a specific output context; used as a taint-tracking sanitizer/barrier.
- `class SafeAccessCheck extends DataFlow::ExprNode instanceof DataFlow::GuardNode; predicate checks(ControlFlowNode node, boolean branch)` — A guard proving a path/value is safe on a given branch; typical isBarrier/sanitizer-guard for path-injection queries.

#### source
- `class RemoteFlowSource extends ThreatModelSource instanceof RemoteFlowSource::Range` — The default taint-tracking source: attacker-controlled remote/network input (request params, headers, body, etc.).

#### structural
- `API::Node API::moduleImport(string); API::Node getMember(string); API::CallNode getACall()` — Resolves references to a specific library function/class/method to build custom source or sink definitions.
- `Expr Node.asExpr(); ControlFlowNode Node.asCfgNode(); ExprNode exprNode(Expr e)` — Converts between a DataFlow::Node and the underlying AST expression/CFG node so arbitrary syntax can seed sources/sinks.
